callees.name: _tarjan_scc
callees.pre_condition: nodes is a non-empty set of FQN strings. edges is a dict mapping each FQN in nodes to a collection of FQN strings representing its in-neighbors, where every target FQN is also a member of nodes.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of lists, where each inner list is a strongly connected component (SCC) containing one or more FQN strings from nodes. Every FQN in nodes appears in exactly one SCC. For every edge u->v in edges, the SCC containing u does not appear after the SCC containing v in the returned list.
